mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bid_record (item_id, bidder_id, bid_amount, is_winning, is_proxy, bid_time) VALUES (#{itemId}, #{bidderId}, #{bidAmount}, #{isWinning}, #{isProxy}, #{bidTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE bid_record SET is_winning = 0 WHERE item_id = #{itemId}
UPDATE bid_record SET is_winning = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM bid_record WHERE item_id = #{itemId} ORDER BY bid_amount DESC, bid_time DESC
SELECT FROM bid_record WHERE item_id = #{itemId} AND is_winning = 1 LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM bid_record WHERE bidder_id = #{bidderId} ORDER BY bid_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bidder_id) FROM bid_record WHERE item_id = #{itemId}
